journey.name: news widget time at large font
journey.description:
At the largest font scale the Bitcoin Headlines widget on Home keeps its time ("4 months ago") on one line at the right of the source row, and a long source name ("Cypherpunk Cogitations") is cut with an ellipsis instead of pushing the time into a one-character column. At the normal font scale the row looks as before: source on the left, time on the right.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, widgets enabled, widgets intro already seen, online so the headlines feed loads. A widget saved earlier may be compact or hide its source or time, so the journey re-saves it as wide with both shown. The headline shown comes from the live feed, so the source name may be short; the time checks hold either way, and the ellipsis check applies only when the source and time do not fit side by side.
iOS: Widget Settings keeps its changes only through Preview; going back discards them, so the journey leaves that screen with Preview. The source and time texts carry no identifiers, so the row checks read a screenshot. The largest text size is `xcrun simctl ui booted content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large` and the default is `content_size large`. iOS words the time as a relative date ("last month", "5 months ago"), so the check is that the time is shown whole, not that it ends with "ago". Before this fix iOS cut both texts ("Cyphe…", "last m…") instead of wrapping the time.

actions.action: Tap the menu icon (id "HeaderMenu") and tap "Widgets"
Tap "Add Widget" and tap the "Bitcoin Headlines" card (id "WidgetListItem-news"); this opens the widget's settings whether or not it is already on Home

Tap Widget Settings (id "WidgetEdit"). Verify from a screenshot that the source row (id "showSource_setting_row") and the date row (id "showDate_setting_row") are both checked; tap an unchecked one to turn it on, then tap Preview (id "WidgetEditPreview")
Swipe the size pager until its label reads "WIDE", tap "Save Widget" (id "WidgetSave") and go back to Home
Scroll Home until the Bitcoin Headlines widget's source row is visible
Verify from a screenshot that the source is at the left of the row and the time at the right, each on one line
Run `xcrun simctl ui booted content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large`
Scroll Home until the source row is visible again
Verify from a screenshot that the time is on one line, shown whole without an ellipsis, and right-aligned in the row
Verify from the same screenshot that the source is on one line and ends before the time; when the source is long, verify that it ends with an ellipsis
Run `xcrun simctl ui booted content_size large`
